documents.means: src (a document section) describes dst's behavior; when dst changes the section may be stale

verifies.means: src (a test) proves dst; when dst changes the test may be stale

references.means: src names dst; no content dependency

realizes.means: src (a document section, code or test) is a projection of dst (a concept): src expresses in its medium what the concept means. When the concept's meaning changes every projection may be stale; when a projection changes it may have outgrown the meaning
